haus_1.thema: identity, the body, a personal fresh start

haus_8.thema: death, crisis, other people's resources, transformation

haus_9.thema: long journeys, higher education, spirituality, foreign lands

haus_12.thema: what is hidden, enemies, retreat, captivity

wirkung_jupiter_als_jahresherrscher.wirkung: The year stands under the sign of growth, expansion, good fortune and success. Favorable for all great undertakings.

wirkung_saturn_als_jahresherrscher.wirkung: The year calls for patience, structure and responsibility. Slowing down, delays, but also lasting results with discipline. Valens: 'Saturn as chronocrator makes the year heavy, but when he is well placed, he builds what endures'.

wirkung_mars_als_jahresherrscher.wirkung: The year brings energy, conflicts, struggles to assert yourself and turning points. Illness, accidents or quarrels are possible; at the same time: great drive and the chance to overcome obstacles.

wirkung_venus_als_jahresherrscher.wirkung: The year brings joy, pleasure, relationships and beauty. Favorable for matters of love, art, social harmony and material comforts.

wirkung_merkur_als_jahresherrscher.wirkung: The year stands under the sign of communication, learning, trade, contracts and intellectual work. An eventful year with many contacts, much information and many decisions.

wirkung_sonne_als_jahresherrscher.wirkung: A year of visibility, authority and work on your identity. The person steps into the foreground: leadership roles, public recognition, but also a confrontation with their own ego and will.

wirkung_mond_als_jahresherrscher.wirkung: A year of change, emotional ups and downs, family events and inner processes. Whatever changes does so quickly. Favorable for everything domestic, motherly and intuitive.
